note: Per symbol: the issuer the house means, and other companies or funds that share (or shared) the ticker. A headline that names an excluded company, or carries a foreign-listing marker for the ticker (LON:XAR, (LSE…), XAR.L), is a collision unless it also names the issuer. Read by scripts/lib/prospectus/news_gate.py (news triggers, the Since-this-report strip) and the quality gate (report facts). Public company names only; no positions.
foreign_markers_note: Exchange prefixes/suffixes below are matched only against the symbol itself, e.g. 'LON:XAR', 'XAR.L', '(LSE: XAR)'.
